scenario.given: A read-only target-version crop reader produces one fresh opaque tile and, after plant, the same fresh opaque crop identity; it observes no mutation or terminal M2 result.
scenario.when: One of till, plant, water, harvest is a typed request whose game-thread coordinator consumes identical scope, observation revision, tile/crop identities, policy, deadline, idempotency, and cancellation authority.
scenario.then: A future bridge-safe native edge must produce the same requestId/executionId terminal succeeded receipt and an exact fresh native tile/crop/inventory delta; this batch's coordinator instead produces source_realization_blocked with no mutation.
scenario.and: The separately owned single_player_sleep_and_advance_day lifecycle must preserve the same tile/crop identity across native day/save/reopen before harvest; M2 neither invokes nor models that lifecycle.
